    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">理解Oracle Property Graph：以账户转账示例完成图特性最小测试</span>
    

</a>
</h2>
    <small>
<span id="post-date" data-last-update-days="0" data-date-updated="2026-09-13 09:13">2026-09-13 09:13</span>&nbsp;
<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jyzhao">AlfredZhao</a>&nbsp;
阅读(<span id="post_view_count">0</span>)&nbsp;
评论(<span id="post_comment_count">0</span>)&nbsp;
&nbsp;
<a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="AddToWz(22953898);return false;">收藏</a>&nbsp;
<a href="https://report.cnblogs.com?targetLink=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cnblogs.com%2Fjyzhao%2Fp%2F22953898&amp;targetId=22953898&amp;targetType=0" target="_blank">举报</a>
</small>
    <div class="entry">
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>Oracle Property Graph 让关系型数据也能用图的方式查询。本文用一组转账数据，走一遍建表、建图、单跳与多跳查询的完整流程，并整理 <code>ORA-40954: unknown label</code> 的常见原因。</p>
<h2 id="01--准备测试表与数据">01 | 准备测试表与数据</h2>
<p>建议在空白 schema 中执行。若对象已存在，先手工删除或更换名称。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">CREATE TABLE money_accounts (
    account_id   NUMBER       CONSTRAINT money_accounts_pk PRIMARY KEY,
    account_name VARCHAR2(50) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE money_transfers (
    transfer_id    NUMBER       CONSTRAINT money_transfers_pk PRIMARY KEY,
    from_account_id NUMBER      NOT NULL,
    to_account_id   NUMBER      NOT NULL,
    amount          NUMBER(12,2),
    transfer_time   TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT money_transfer_from_fk
        FOREIGN KEY (from_account_id)
        REFERENCES money_accounts(account_id),
    CONSTRAINT money_transfer_to_fk
        FOREIGN KEY (to_account_id)
        REFERENCES money_accounts(account_id)
);
</code></pre>
<p>插入 6 个账户：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">INSERT INTO money_accounts VALUES (1, '账户A');
INSERT INTO money_accounts VALUES (2, '账户B');
INSERT INTO money_accounts VALUES (3, '账户C');
INSERT INTO money_accounts VALUES (4, '账户D');
INSERT INTO money_accounts VALUES (5, '账户E');
INSERT INTO money_accounts VALUES (6, '账户F');
</code></pre>
<p>构造一条连续转账链，并增加一条捷径：</p>
<div class="mermaid">graph LR
    A[A] --&gt; B[B]
    B --&gt; C[C]
    C --&gt; D[D]
    D --&gt; E[E]
    E --&gt; F[F]

    %% 分支/快捷路径
    B --&gt;|快捷路径| E
</div><pre><code class="language-sql">INSERT INTO money_transfers
VALUES (101, 1, 2, 1000, TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 09:00:00');
INSERT INTO money_transfers
VALUES (102, 2, 3, 900, TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 10:00:00');
INSERT INTO money_transfers
VALUES (103, 3, 4, 800, TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 11:00:00');
INSERT INTO money_transfers
VALUES (104, 4, 5, 700, TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 12:00:00');
INSERT INTO money_transfers
VALUES (105, 5, 6, 600, TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 13:00:00');
-- B 直接转到 E，形成另一条路径
INSERT INTO money_transfers
VALUES (106, 2, 5, 500, TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 14:00:00');
COMMIT;
</code></pre>
<h2 id="02--创建属性图">02 | 创建属性图</h2>
<p>显式声明两个标签：<code>ACCOUNT</code> 是顶点标签，<code>TRANSFER</code> 是边标签。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH money_graph
  VERTEX TABLES (
    money_accounts
      KEY (account_id)
      LABEL account
      PROPERTIES (
        account_id,
        account_name
      )
  )
  EDGE TABLES (
    money_transfers
      KEY (transfer_id)
      SOURCE KEY (from_account_id)
        REFERENCES money_accounts (account_id)
      DESTINATION KEY (to_account_id)
        REFERENCES money_accounts (account_id)
      LABEL transfer
      PROPERTIES (
        transfer_id,
        amount,
        transfer_time
      )
  );
</code></pre>
<p>未加双引号的标识符会被 Oracle 规范化为大写，因此 <code>LABEL account</code> 可以通过 <code>IS ACCOUNT</code> 匹配。</p>
<h2 id="03--单跳查询">03 | 单跳查询</h2>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT *
FROM GRAPH_TABLE(
  money_graph
  MATCH (a IS ACCOUNT)-[t IS TRANSFER]-&gt;(b IS ACCOUNT)
  COLUMNS (
    a.account_id   AS source_account,
    a.account_name AS source_name,
    t.amount       AS amount,
    b.account_id   AS target_account,
    b.account_name AS target_name
  )
)
ORDER BY source_account, target_account;
</code></pre>
<p>它应返回 6 条直接转账关系。</p>
<h2 id="04--15-跳查询">04 | 1～5 跳查询</h2>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT *
FROM GRAPH_TABLE(
  money_graph
  MATCH (a IS ACCOUNT)-[IS TRANSFER]-&gt;{1,5}(b IS ACCOUNT)
  COLUMNS (
    a.account_id   AS source_account,
    a.account_name AS source_name,
    b.account_id   AS target_account,
    b.account_name AS target_name
  )
)
WHERE source_account = 1
ORDER BY target_account;
</code></pre>
<p>从账户 A 出发，可以匹配到：</p>
<ul>
<li>A→B：1 跳</li>
<li>A→B→C：2 跳</li>
<li>A→B→C→D：3 跳</li>
<li>A→B→C→D→E：4 跳</li>
<li>A→B→C→D→E→F：5 跳</li>
<li>A→B→E：另一条 2 跳路径</li>
<li>A→B→E→F：另一条 3 跳路径</li>
</ul>
<p>因此 E 和 F 可能出现多次，因为查询匹配的是“路径”，而不只是去重后的终点。如果只想看可达账户，可以在外层去重：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT DISTINCT target_account, target_name
FROM GRAPH_TABLE(
  money_graph
  MATCH (a IS ACCOUNT)-[IS TRANSFER]-&gt;{1,5}(b IS ACCOUNT)
  COLUMNS (
    a.account_id   AS source_account,
    b.account_id   AS target_account,
    b.account_name AS target_name
  )
)
WHERE source_account = 1
ORDER BY target_account;
</code></pre>
<h2 id="05--ora-40954-常见原因">05 | ORA-40954 常见原因</h2>
<h3 id="-把表名当成标签名">① 把表名当成标签名</h3>
<p>图定义是 <code>LABEL account</code>，正确匹配是 <code>(a IS ACCOUNT)</code>，而不是 <code>(a IS MONEY_ACCOUNTS)</code>。<code>IS</code> 后面填的是 Label，不是底层表名。</p>
<h3 id="-没有显式声明预期标签">② 没有显式声明预期标签</h3>
<p>如果图定义没有 <code>LABEL account</code>，却查询 <code>(a IS ACCOUNT)</code>，Oracle 就可能找不到该标签。建议在教学和生产 DDL 中显式声明 Label。</p>
<h3 id="-双引号导致大小写敏感">③ 双引号导致大小写敏感</h3>
<p>若创建时写 <code>LABEL "Account"</code>，标签名就是大小写敏感的 <code>Account</code>，查询必须写 <code>(a IS "Account")</code>，<code>(a IS ACCOUNT)</code> 无法匹配。最佳实践是标签不使用双引号。</p>
<h3 id="-标签存在但元素类型用错">④ 标签存在，但元素类型用错</h3>
<p><code>TRANSFER</code> 只定义在边上，却写成 <code>(a IS TRANSFER)</code>；或 <code>ACCOUNT</code> 只定义在顶点上，却写成 <code>-[e IS ACCOUNT]-&gt;</code>，都会出现标签无法用于当前位置的问题。</p>
<h3 id="快速定位是哪一个标签有问题">快速定位是哪一个标签有问题</h3>
<p>先单独测试顶点标签：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT *
FROM GRAPH_TABLE(
  money_graph
  MATCH (a IS ACCOUNT)
  COLUMNS (a.account_id AS account_id)
);
</code></pre>
<p>再单独测试边标签：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT *
FROM GRAPH_TABLE(
  money_graph
  MATCH (a)-[t IS TRANSFER]-&gt;(b)
  COLUMNS (t.transfer_id AS transfer_id)
);
</code></pre>
<p>第一个失败说明 <code>ACCOUNT</code> 标签有问题；第二个失败说明 <code>TRANSFER</code> 标签有问题。</p>
<p>关注我，和AI一起成长~</p>
